description: Renovate opens the dependency update pull requests of this repository with the shared preset of dan-petty/infra: the schedule, the groups, the labels and the automerge of each update after all checks pass. This repository is the template source, not a render of it, so it has no copier update. config:recommended ignores each tests/ folder, but the tests of this repository are checks that CI runs, so Renovate updates them too.

customManagers.description: The Renovate release of tests/test-repository-template.sh, which runs the config validator with npx, and the release-please release whose schemas the test reads.

packageRules.description: Renovate publishes several releases a day, so even a patch of the npm package waits for the schedule, as the Renovate images do in the base preset.
